scope: Raft marketing reference plus OpenTag Landing, Features, login, register, valid/current-account join, anonymous join, invalid invite, Bootstrap loading, Bootstrap transport failure and retry across the locked desktop and mobile viewports

interactionEvidence.publicSurfaces: anonymous Landing and Features opt into the Raft yellow/pink/black square-border visual only when the Preview shell resolves Baseline; the first hero card remains a real static OpenTag collaboration sample and both pages measured zero horizontal overflow
interactionEvidence.authForms: login, register and anonymous join retain native form submission, required/email validation, localized stable backend errors, composition-safe Enter handling, aria-busy plus explicit busy disabling, 48px primary controls and 44px mobile secondary targets
interactionEvidence.authDeepLinks: an anonymous protected channel+thread+hash deep-link redirected through the encoded same-app returnTo value and the browser-only login fixture returned to the exact original channel, query and hash; external and protocol-relative returnTo values are rejected by the pure routing contract
interactionEvidence.inviteStates: temporary real active and expired join-link fixtures verified current-account, anonymous register and expired flows and were deleted after capture; an unknown token rendered invalid; a browser-only transport failure rendered localized retry UI and retry transitioned to the authoritative invalid-token response
interactionEvidence.bootstrapLoading: a delayed real /api/auth/me response rendered the workspace Skeleton at 1440x900, 390x844 and 375x812 without painting Landing or protected workspace content
interactionEvidence.bootstrapRecovery: a browser-only forced /api/auth/me transport rejection rendered an understandable retry alert, retained the stored token, and a retry after restoring fetch navigated to the original protected workspace route
interactionEvidence.classicRollback: ?ui=classic resolved document shell=classic and Landing class=lp-root without lp-baseline; static prerender has no AppShellProvider and fails closed to Classic

contractRegression.previewBuild: 2558 modules transformed and Landing prerender injected

intentionalDifferences: Raft exposes only its marketing site publicly in this test environment, so OpenTag login/register/join use the measured Raft marketing primitives rather than copying an unavailable private authentication page.
OpenTag keeps its real self-hosted account, invite-token, role, workspace-resolution and localized backend error contracts; no identity or server API was changed.
OpenTag keeps its existing marketing content and real product mock instead of copying Raft claims, assets or private workspace data.
Classic remains unchanged as the default and immediate rollback surface.
